paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Critic model choices. Both follow the SIM-RAG setting with GPT-4 as the Reasoner, but the blue bar uses learned Flan-T5-783M as a Critic, while the red bar uses GPT-4 as the Critic (a.k.a., self-critique).

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates performance metrics labeled as "EM" and "F1" for two models, Flan-T5-783M and GPT-4, across different question-answering datasets: TriviaQA, HotPotQA, and 2Wiki. The horizontal axis is categorical, listing the datasets with performance metrics in the order "TriviaQA (EM)", "HotPotQA (EM)", "2Wiki (EM)", "TriviaQA (F1)", "HotPotQA (F1)", and "2Wiki (F1)". The vertical axis represents the performance values on a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 85, with tick intervals every 20 units. The bars for Flan-T5-783M are colored blue, while the bars for GPT-4 are red. For "TriviaQA (EM)", the blue bar measures approximately 77.3 and the red bar 77.1. In "HotPotQA (EM)", the blue bar is about 37.0, and the red bar is around 31.9. The "2Wiki (EM)" category shows the blue bar at approximately 44.5 and the red bar at 32.5. For "TriviaQA (F1)", the values are approximately 82.8 for the blue bar and 83.8 for the red. In "HotPotQA (F1)", the blue bar measures about 49.7, with the red at 43.3. In "2Wiki (F1)", the blue bar is approximately 53.3, and the red is 38.1. The bars are not sorted by height or any specific order beyond the dataset categorization, and there is no visual emphasis, such as shading or bolding, present on any bars. The legend in the top right indicates the color association with each model.
